finding.expected: Add deterministic offline regression proving non-product account/profile/navigation-like text cannot enter the persisted JSON projection while representative title, price, attributes/specification, seller/product-service, and other intended product-page observations remain capturable within the bounded projection. Do not weaken existing safety, identity, one-shot, or byte-bound regressions.
finding.issue: The 203-pass offline suite contains no regression proving that account/profile/navigation text outside the admitted product scope is excluded from the persisted projection, so the required sanitation property is not established by Runtime verification.

original_constraints: Projection capture is a bounded rendered-source observation, not raw DOM serialization. It must include deterministic ordered records sufficient to inspect page-visible product information and structural context, using only bounded safe fields such as tag_name, role, itemprop, data-testid, data-e2e, section/heading context and clipped visible text. It must exclude input values, script/style content, raw attributes outside the allowlist, href/query strings, event handlers, hidden text, raw HTML, account/session metadata and browser/runtime secrets.

Projection traversal must have explicit hard bounds for total scanned nodes, persisted records, per-text length and total serialized bytes. If any bound is reached, the projection must set an explicit truncation flag and preserve deterministic order; truncation must never be silently treated as exhaustive page coverage.

The projection must establish exact source binding independently through the observed URL/source ID and fail closed on mismatch, login/challenge/unavailable/unrelated states, missing page identity, malformed projection schema or unsafe content.

The carrier borrows the existing already-open session and performs zero navigation and zero interactive browser actions. It may call evaluate exactly once to produce the sanitized projection and screenshot exactly once using the existing BrowserSession screenshot capability. It must always release/close only the borrowed session according to existing lifecycle ownership without closing the Human-owned browser.

Modify exactly the nine authorized paths. Runtime verification is fully offline with fake BrowserSession/manager behavior, contains zero TikTok/CDP/network/browser operations, and must prove artifact schema, bounds, sanitation, create-exclusive semantics, consumption behavior, identity fail-closed behavior and no extra files.
Executor must not review, publish, perform the Human live capture or start any successor work.
